# SpotsVault

> Canadian peer-to-peer marketplace for parking and storage spaces — find a spot near you, or list your unused driveway, garage, or storage space and earn.

SpotsVault connects renters with hosts who have unused parking or storage space, starting in the Ottawa-Gatineau region and expanding across Canada. Renters search by location and book instantly or on request; hosts list a space in a few guided steps (choose parking or storage, add address and photos, set price and availability, get approved) and set their own price rather than a platform-fixed rate. Booking, secure escrow payments (including pay-in-installments for longer bookings), and in-app messaging are built in.

## Key facts
- Hosts set their own hourly, daily, weekly, or monthly price — there is no fixed platform rate.
- Typical downtown Ottawa monthly garage parking runs roughly $110–$240/month; SpotsVault hosts often price well under that since a driveway or residential spot has none of a garage's overhead.
- New listings are reviewed before going live; renter payments are held in escrow and released to the host on the agreed schedule.
- Available in English and French.

## Pages
- [Home](/): Overview of SpotsVault, how listing and booking work, and pricing compared to traditional parking
- [Find a Spot](/find): Unified search for parking and storage with location and distance filters
- [Find Parking](/parking): Browse parking spaces with map view
- [Find Storage](/storage): Browse and compare storage spaces by size, price, and city
- [List Your Space](/list): Host onboarding to list a parking or storage space
